title: Hackers Are Serving Malware To iPhones Via Hundreds Of Infected Websites
content_md: Thomas Brewster reports: Crypto thieves are targeting iPhone users at scale with a sneaky kind of cyberattack that only requires victims to view an ad or visit an infected webpage, researchers tell Forbes. Hundreds of websites have been compromised as part of the hack, they say and, in one case, a malware ad was served… Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/10/27/hackers-are-serving-malware-to-iphones-via-hundreds-of-infected-websites/
